teamUpAbilities.name: Cosmic Cyclone
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Modifies Soulbond passive so that any linked teammates immediately receive an active movement speed boost.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Linked teammates additionally gain a direct flat damage boost while Soulbond is active.

teamUpAbilities.name: Stark Protocol
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Increases maximum ammo capacity and modifies the Cosmic Cluster right-click to provide healing to allies on top of damaging enemies.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Cosmic Cluster creates a localized explosion upon impact that can heal and damage in an AoE field.

teamUpAbilities.name: Elemental Storing
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Triggers stored armor power to deal area damage and apply a heavy slow to nearby enemies while automatically attaching a Vibranium Mark.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Enemies caught within the active ability's range are physically pulled/launched directly toward Black Panther.

teamUpAbilities.name: Dimensional Shortcut
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Spawns a limbo stepping disc portal allowing Black Panther to instantly teleport back to his position from a few seconds ago while gaining bonus health. Discs explode to apply a Vibranium Mark on exit.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: The active teleportation transit sequence can be manually cancelled mid-transit to trigger immediate localized blast drops.

teamUpAbilities.name: Allied Agents
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Landing primary fire hits builds focus. At 3 stacks, enters a Focus State where the next bullet deals boosted damage and pierces targets.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Scoring any critical hit while in the Focus State prevents the focus meter from expiring, allowing infinite chain states if aim is perfect.

teamUpAbilities.name: Burning Bullets
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Activating the ability grants a massive primary weapon fire rate boost and turns the Plasma Cannon into an uncharged instant hitscan laser.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Grants a second full ability charge of the fire rate and laser buff state to use back-to-back.

teamUpAbilities.name: Savage Slam
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Leap high to smash the ground dealing damage and reducing kit cooldowns (Gamma Bubble/Exile) based on remaining missing health.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Ground slam additionally applies vulnerability to all enemies hit.

teamUpAbilities.name: Gamma Fastball
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Enter a Furious State gaining movement and attack speed boosts. Unlocks 'Scars of Rage' granting Unstoppable status at low health.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Classic Fastball Special returns: Hulk throws Wolverine forward, triggering Furious State on both heroes simultaneously (15s cooldown).

teamUpAbilities.name: Voltaic Union
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Modifies Sentinel Strike into a lightning shield projectile. Landing 2 hits allows launching piercing lightning shield 4 times. Multiple throws on activation.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Empowers shield with an AoE damaging splash lightning effect from the shield throw (16s cooldown).

teamUpAbilities.name: Mutual Rally
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Leap directly to a teammate, providing bonus health to both yourself and the ally while redirecting incoming damage to Cap.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Triggers a mutual rally charging at one another, slamming to grant bonus health and movement speed to nearby allies. Targeted ally gets extra speed boost.

teamUpAbilities.name: Oblivion Shroud
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Veil of Light Force and Terror Cape change into Twilight Veil and Void Veil. After traveling a set distance, veils halt in place; enemy damage passing through Twilight Veil is weakened, and enemy healing passing through Void Veil is reduced.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Expands the active width of both veils. Allies passing through the veils are empowered by Hellfire energy to gain a damage boost.

teamUpAbilities.name: Frozen Haven
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: New active ability on a 20s cooldown that channels frost energy to encase yourself in an absolute block of ice, protecting you while emitting a weak healing aura to nearby allies.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: The healing aura emitted while encased inside the absolute block of ice becomes significantly stronger (perfect for protecting ultimate channels).

teamUpAbilities.name: Gamma Maelstrom
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Upgrades Maelstrom of Madness energy charge rate and fully removes the anti-heal self-inflicted curse.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Retains stored gamma energy (drops only to 50% instead of 0%) upon using the AoE pop, and energy doesn't decay over time.

teamUpAbilities.name: Psionic Vortex
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Upgrades Maelstrom of Madness to Psionic Vortex, pulling enemies toward you and increasing shield values.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Any damage dealt by Psionic Vortex gives proportional bonus health to Doctor Strange.

teamUpAbilities.name: Wild Wall
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Summon a Wild Wall providing continuous healing and bonus health to allies within its active field range.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: The Wild Wall evolves after hitting healing thresholds, drastically increasing its healing-over-time output.

teamUpAbilities.name: Bubble Buddies
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Groot retreats completely inside a bubble shield to enter an invincible state alongside targeted continuous self-healing (20s cooldown).
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: The healing inside the bubble increases significantly and translates directly into bonus health overcaps.

teamUpAbilities.name: Moonlight Slash
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Crescent Slash fires a forward energy wave that heals and boosts teammate healing while damaging and applying vulnerability to enemies.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Grants Hawkeye an active, fluid three-hit melee slashing combo pattern instead of a single slash.

teamUpAbilities.name: Psionic Arrows
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Upgrades Blast Arrow. Holding down the draw continuously accumulates extra tracking psionic arrows that fire simultaneously upon release.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: The accumulated psionic arrows travel significantly faster and explode directly upon hitting any enemy or the terrain environment.

teamUpAbilities.name: Hell Tendrils
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Replaces Soul Drainer with active Hell Tendrils. Impact pulls nearby enemies together and tethers them, slowing targets trying to flee.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Upgrades Piercing Night right-click to unleash a rapid volley of symbiote infused swords where each direct hit heals Hela.

teamUpAbilities.name: Deep Wrath
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Passive: Participating in any enemy KO automatically spawns an undead monstro turret. Using Piercing Night commands the turret to fire at targets.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: During her ultimate form, every single descending projectile impact point automatically spawns a new undead monstro turret.

teamUpAbilities.name: Kuan-Yin Palm
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Landing hits with flurry strikes releases an active burst of healing to all surrounding brawling or diving teammates.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Significantly extends total target lock-on engagement distance for starting flurry rushes.

teamUpAbilities.name: Iron and Stone
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Adds a rising uppercut skill on an 8s cooldown that launches targeted enemies upward to extend airborne combo gameplay loops.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Enables Iron Fist to chain the rising uppercut directly into a sweeping ground leg strike follow-up for heavy squash lethality.

teamUpAbilities.name: Gamma Charge
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Upgrades Armor Overdrive into Gamma Overdrive, rewarding Iron Man with a localized gamma shield and significantly boosting Repulsor and Unibeam damage.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Enables Invincible Pulse Cannon, granting a massive gamma shield and firing heavily infused blasts that deal continuous passive flight damage.

teamUpAbilities.name: Thunder Overdrive
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Permanently enhances Unibeam (in and out of overdrive) to emit bounding lightning energy that deals bonus damage to targets near the beam edge.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Reduces the active cooldown of Armor Overdrive from a standard 20 seconds down to a rapid 15 seconds.

teamUpAbilities.name: Guardian of the Deep
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Shoots out healing tendrils that link to allies to provide continuous healing, converting excess healing directly into overcap bonus health.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Adds symbiotic tendrils that lash out at nearby enemies within range to inflict continuous passive damage.

teamUpAbilities.name: Mr. Pool's Interdimensional Toy Box
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: New ability on a 15s cooldown that spits out a Deadpool plushie that continuously taunt nearby enemies while spraying a healing mist onto surrounding allies.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: The Deadpool plushie exerts a much stronger taunt pull while concurrently dealing area damage to enemies caught in its radius.

teamUpAbilities.name: Vibrant Vitality
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Crystals are upgraded to permanently provide a damage boost to affecting allies within their active range and expanded radius.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Crystals emit a natural energy shockwave that damages enemies within a radius and slightly launches them upward.

teamUpAbilities.name: Villain's Illusion
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: New active ability allowing Loki to target any fallen hero (friend or foe) to assume their form and use their standard abilities for a set time (cannot use their ultimate).
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Transformation duration is increased. If Loki dies while transformed or while ulting, he does not die; he safely reverts back to Loki with health remaining.

teamUpAbilities.name: Atlas Bond
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Unleashes a Spirit Fox that charms enemies and heals allies in its path. Activating it instantly cleanses all negative status effects on Luna Snow.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: The Spirit Fox automatically returns after reaching its maximum distance, and the self-cleanse behavior is retained.

teamUpAbilities.name: Duality Dance
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Casts a localized soul bond tethering characters in range; attacking tethered enemies or healing linked allies restores Luna's personal health.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Scoring critical hits with Light and Dark Ice primary attacks directly reduces the active cooldowns of her Freeze and Ice Arts abilities.

teamUpAbilities.name: Chaining Agamotto
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Active tether skill that hooks and drags two targeted enemies together to the same location simultaneously to enable combo grouping.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Removes the target cap limit completely, enabling Magik to tether and pull an entire enemy squad to a single point.

teamUpAbilities.name: Void Pentagram
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Casting stepping discs inside a void magic circle instantly refunds ability energy and automatically spawns a helpful limbo demon minion.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: The summoned limbo demon minions receive heavily increased flat health pools and a wider melee attack sweep range.

teamUpAbilities.name: Metallic Chaos
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Grants permanent access to the classic ranged bolts weapon on a low 12-second cooldown.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Transforms Mag Cannon (right-click) into a Kamehameha-style beam burning energy to fire chaotic great swords for extreme damage.

teamUpAbilities.name: Echoing Projection
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Cast a magnetic projection echo that mimics Magneto's movements and attacks perfectly from the enemy perspective (15s cooldown).
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: The echoes never decay or go away automatically, possessing high health pools until killed (creates a 7v6 scenario).

teamUpAbilities.name: Star Blossom
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Allows Mantis to use AoE healing by recasting her healing flower on a teammate, spreading an enhanced healing aura.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Always triggers the maximum enhanced spell and healing effect continuously without manual recasts.

teamUpAbilities.name: Vitality Pack
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Upon defeat, Mantis can move freely as a soul to lightly heal nearby allies and reforge her body at a chosen spot. Using Natural Anger enhances Nature's Favor healing.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Soul state can forge a soul bond with nearby teammates upon death to grant healing over time and distribute incoming damage taken across the bond.

teamUpAbilities.name: Luminous Moon
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: New active skill on a 15s cooldown that lets Moon Knight enter a phased state to dash forward, emitting a light energy wave that heals himself and allies.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Extends phase duration and dash range while significantly expanding the healing wave's radius and scaling up total health output.

teamUpAbilities.name: Blood Moon
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Deploys ankh traps that materialize a Talon of Khonshu upon trigger, pulling nearby caught enemies directly into the center of the trap zone.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Ankh traps summon multiple overlapping Talons of Khonshu to continuously bombard the trapped zone (supports 4 active ankhs).

teamUpAbilities.name: Tidal Wave
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Active ability summoning a massive forward-rolling wave that knocks back enemies and inflicts a movement slow debuff.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Grants two full charges of Tidal Wave. Waves crash down at maximum distance to deal secondary area damage and re-apply slows.

teamUpAbilities.name: Gamma Monstro
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Landing critical hits automatically summons an extra Gamma Monstro squid turret that gains attack speed and fires a beam when using Wrath of the Seas.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Casting Blessing of the Deep creates a gamma-infused water barrier that accelerates turret cooldowns and boosts damage while inside.

teamUpAbilities.name: Vibranium Mech
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Boosts primary attack speed and damage, and deploys a frontal 300 HP vibranium shield while reducing web energy costs (6s duration).
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Shield increases to 400 HP and turns Penny's primary fire into a rapid machine gun output.

teamUpAbilities.name: Rocket Network
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Deploy a secondary nest that periodically drops tracking spider drones and armor packs for team bonus health.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: The secondary nest passively regenerates its own health pool over time, and Rocket's BRB creates webs, drones, and mines.

teamUpAbilities.name: Light and Dark Darts
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Fires a ring of light darts dealing damage and stealing health, leaving a shadow domain puddle that grants immediate stealth upon entry.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Expands shadow domain radius. Re-entering the zone continuously refires the light dart ring in all directions to lock down 1v1s.

teamUpAbilities.name: Mental Projection
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Creates a forward-dashing clone illusion that mimics Psylocke's melee strikes while the real Psylocke enters a temporary cloaked stealth state.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Elevates mental power, allowing Psylocke to reactivate the skill to instantly swap physical places with her active illusion clone.

teamUpAbilities.name: Ammo Overload
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Throws down an ammo overload device in a target direction on a 25s cooldown. Entering its range grants a heavily increased firing rate.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: The device grants both infinite ammo and the increased firing rate simultaneously while inside its radius.

teamUpAbilities.name: Piercing Vision
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Fires a high-damage piercing bullet that carries an integrated flat damage boost effect.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: The bullet gains heavily increased projectile speed when piercing through enemies, summoned player walls, and shields.

teamUpAbilities.name: Planet X Pals
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Converts bombard mode main damage to thorny spores on a 10s+ cooldown. Spores deal continuous damage to enemies while healing and granting bonus health to allies in a radius.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Extends the activation duration of thorny spores significantly while riding on Groot's shoulders.

teamUpAbilities.name: Mammalian Bond
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Tosses out collectible acorns that teammates can pick up to receive a burst of healing and a global cooldown reduction on their abilities.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Increases the maximum charge count for throwing out acorns.

teamUpAbilities.name: Sorcerer Supreme
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Replaces standard right-click projectiles with a hold-down channel that releases a massive stream of continuous high-damage magic energy.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Increases total channel resource pool capacity and causes Chaos Control to generate energy significantly faster when attacking.

teamUpAbilities.name: Hex Fireworks
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Infuses fireworks into Dark Seal forcefields, changing it into a plasmoid shield. Recasting detonates it for area damage and vulnerability.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Scarlet Witch receives constant passive self-healing from firework energy whenever she is actively using Mystic Projection.

teamUpAbilities.name: Symbiote Bond
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Activating symbiote form turns tendrils into explosive ground spikes that deal area damage, knock back enemies, and grant 90% invincibility.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Triggers additional clinging tendrils that continuously tether and damage all enemies caught near the spike zone.

teamUpAbilities.name: Sticky Trap
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Tosses a sticky spider bomb that deals damage and tracks targets. Detonating it on Spider-Man instantly recharges all web cluster shots.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Spider tracers applied by web clusters are heavily upgraded. Detonating these marks rewards Spider-Man with immediate bonus health.

teamUpAbilities.name: Squirrel Missile
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Launches a tracking squirrel projectile that rides on Iron Man's nanotech glove to hunt down a designated target as a homing missile.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Launching an acorn to imprison/stun a target automatically fires an extra synchronized tracking squirrel missile at them.

teamUpAbilities.name: ESU Alumni
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Gains an explosive web bomb ability that can be thrown to deal localized splash damage and briefly slow all caught enemies.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Web bombs leave a sticky web puddle on the floor that continuously damages, slows, and scales into a full stun over time.

teamUpAbilities.name: Thorn Snares
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Tosses twisted thorn seeds that rapidly sprout into floor snares, dealing damage and trapping stepping enemies in a direct root effect.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Increases total number of thorn snares deployed simultaneously and boosts flat snare damage values.

teamUpAbilities.name: Star Soul
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Deploys a telekinetic beacon on a 100s cooldown that Star-Lord can teleport back to. If the beacon is alive when Star-Lord dies, he instantly respawns at it.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Participating in any enemy KO directly reduces the active remaining cooldown of the telekinetic resurrection beacon.

teamUpAbilities.name: God of Thunder
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Upgrades Windblade primary attack permanently into a hitscan lightning beam that detonates for damage on impact (retains fall-off; can headshot).
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Replaces Bolt Rush with Chain Lightning on a 5s cooldown, allowing attacks to bounce from target to target across groups.

teamUpAbilities.name: Jaws of Fate
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: New active ability on a 15s cooldown that unleashes a localized downpour continuously healing Storm and her occupying allies.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: During Omega Hurricane, Jeff can swim inside the cyclone to transform it into a massive healing and damaging Jeff-Nato.

teamUpAbilities.name: Ragnarok Rebirth
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Passive: Upon taking fatal damage, death is prevented and Thor gains a decaying pool of bonus health. Securing a kill resurrects him.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: If Thor or Hela secure a kill while the passive is active, Thor instantly revives, translating bonus health into permanent health plus continuous healing.

teamUpAbilities.name: Divine Armory
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Adds a throwable thunder spear ability that restores Thor Force per enemy struck; Thor can leap to the spear location (20s cooldown).
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Leaping directly to the spear grants a chunk of immediate bonus health.

teamUpAbilities.name: Blood Leech
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Right-click cellular corrosion siphons health continuously from every single connected/linked enemy target.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Gains an additional burst of health upon activating specific movement and diving abilities (Swing, E, Dive).

teamUpAbilities.name: Abyssal Flames
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Ignites symbiote with Phoenix Flames, replacing primary attacks with a wide, sweeping frontal claw slash with extended range.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Primary attacks apply Sparks that detonate upon reaching 3 stacks on a target.

teamUpAbilities.name: Timeless Veterans
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Unlocks Burst Spike. Activating the bionic arm emits a forward arc of electricity that deals damage and knocks back blocking or approaching targets.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: The electric burst applies a direct grounded crowd control status effect and amplifies the physical knockback distance.

teamUpAbilities.name: Expert Instinct
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Passive: Securing or assisting in an enemy KO grants stacks of Cooling Instinct, reducing all active kit cooldowns. Stacks clear on death.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Significantly boosts the maximum flat overshield bonus health capacity generated by Winter Soldier's natural bionic arm passive.

teamUpAbilities.name: Blast Slash
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Extends attack range on Savage Claw and Berserk Claw. Replaces Vicious Rampage with Kinetic Claws, lunging forward in a heavy slashing flurry.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: The extended range Blast Slash state becomes permanently and passively active on his primary right-click at all times.

teamUpAbilities.name: Pair of Threes
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Activating the skill grants a kinetic speed and jump height boost, embedding particles on enemies that detonate after a delay for bonus damage.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Wolverine receives high continuous passive health regeneration for the entire duration of the active kinetic boost state.

teamUpAbilities.name: Fantastic Amplifier
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Equips a permanent amplifier boosting maximum elasticity limits and enabling manual activation of his ballooned inflation block state.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Brainiac Bounce successfully launches and knocks down all impacted enemy targets caught beneath the drop zone.

teamUpAbilities.name: Clobbering Research
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Brawler stance stretch punch becomes a chargeable attack on a 20s cooldown, rewarding scaling bonus health on hit and launching enemies at full charge.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Distended Grip upgrades to a heavy charged hammer smash that rewards massive overcap health chunks and knocks up multiple targets.

teamUpAbilities.name: United Siblings
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Generates a flame shield for herself or a targeted ally that blocks damage while emitting a healing aura. Teammate projectiles fired through it gain a damage boost; enemies passing through are slowed.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Boasts a larger shield radius and a heavily increased flat shield block value.

teamUpAbilities.name: First Family
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: New active ability on a 20s cooldown that turns Invisible Woman and surrounding allies completely invisible, granting healing and a speed boost. Disengaging from combat lets you re-enter stealth.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: The healing and speed boost effects are heavily enhanced, and the active duration of the invisible state is increased.

teamUpAbilities.name: Fiery Sparks
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Gains a passive aura on a 15s cooldown that continuously ticks away chip fire damage to all enemies caught within a close radius of his body.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Activating the close-range fire aura immediately grants Johnny a chunk of bonus health overcaps to assist flyer survival loops.

teamUpAbilities.name: Storming Ignition
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Active skill on a 20s cooldown releasing a forward stream of pulling fire. Omega Hurricane sweeping across it transforms fields into moving flame tornadoes.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Increases the maximum simultaneous flame tornado cap from 3 up to 6, creating total point-wipe configurations.

teamUpAbilities.name: Two In One
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Enter an enhanced flame state where Rocky Jab deals splash damage and Stone Haymaker causes a frontal cone explosion (15s cooldown).
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Allows Human Torch to lift and throw The Thing down to trigger a massive area stun, automatically entering the flame state (30s cooldown).

teamUpAbilities.name: Unbreakable Forces
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Generate a layer of psionic armor granting bonus health scaling off current missing health pools.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: While active, taking chunks of damage causes the armor to pulse healing waves to allies and boosts health conversion ratio.

teamUpAbilities.name: Iced Out Diamond
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Projects ice energy forward to slow/damage. Diamond form condenses frost into an absolute zero barrier blocking attacks.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: While in diamond form, all basic attacks and the ultimate utility apply an extra stacking slow movement debuff.

teamUpAbilities.name: Spirit Breaker
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Adds an effect to Psychic Spear that converts damage dealt directly into immediate personal bonus health.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Shattering a spear point grants instant bonus health overcaps and takes several seconds off the active ability cooldown.

teamUpAbilities.name: Stark Protocol
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Replaces primary weapon fire with a piercing Nano-Ray that heals allies and damages enemies simultaneously.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Enhances Imperative Firewall to fire powerful homing missiles at enemies in range, causing area damage.

teamUpAbilities.name: Spider Sync
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: New ability that instantly applies tracking drones to all allies simultaneously instead of just a single target.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Imperative Firewall applies to all drones, allowing the ability effects to be triggered multiple times simultaneously for massive AoE healing on a 15s cooldown.

teamUpAbilities.name: Circle of Life
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Replaces Psionic Detonation with Netherfire, applying a mark that causes secondary micro-stuns, anti-healing reduction, and sparks on a 12s cooldown.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Every consecutive netherfire explosion blast automatically inflicts multiple overlapping stacks of Sparks onto caught units.

teamUpAbilities.name: Telekinetic Beatdown
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Active skill on a 12s cooldown firing a shockwave that commands the Phoenix Force to punch a target and rapidly blink strike nearby units while healing Phoenix.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Adds an extra spark stack per hit, enhances personal self-healing outputs, and scales up the maximum number of consecutive blink strikes.

teamUpAbilities.name: Blade of Khonshu
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Performs a heavy forward cleaving lunge that executes 4 rapid sword slashes, throwing tracking dark moon blades that bounce across nearby targets.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Each consecutive whirlwind sword slash triggers and throws one extra ricocheting dark moon blade into the enemy cluster.

teamUpAbilities.name: Bleed for Battle
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Passive: Taking set damage thresholds builds bloodline awakening stacks to enhance speed and kit performance.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Taking critical health damage instantly triggers Bloodline Awakening while significantly raising the overall stack cap to unlock extreme scaling.

teamUpAbilities.name: Odin's Unacknowledged
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Projects an illusion forward utilizing Assassin's Charge to pin and carry struck enemies through the air without consuming your real charge.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Grants two full charges of the illusion projectile on a 15-second cooldown.

teamUpAbilities.name: Guardians of the Galaxy
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: First cast reveals a targeted area (UAV style). Second cast performs a diving slam attack that grounds hit enemies (25s cooldown).
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Angela gains an immediate chunk of bonus health scaling directly with the number of enemies hit by the slam.

teamUpAbilities.name: Comprehensive Defense
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Upgrades right-click to block, parry, and deflect incoming projectile weapons from all directions while actively generating fury resource points.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Passively recovers health continuously for the entire active channel duration of the multi-directional parry block.

teamUpAbilities.name: Devilish Affair
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: New active skill on a 12s cooldown swinging chains in a wide crisscross pattern to damage and slow multiple forward targets (chains with Righteous Cross).
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Significantly expands the physical chain damage sweep radius and rewards immediate fury resource points upon landing hits.

teamUpAbilities.name: Favorable Odds
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: New ability on a 12s cooldown throwing two magnetic playing cards that create an environmental sphere repelling and launching enemies, or acts as a healing bubble for allies.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: The magnetic poles of the cards reverse upon landing, slamming back together and exploding for a burst of area healing to allies and damage to enemies.

teamUpAbilities.name: Sparkling Staff
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: New ability on a 12s cooldown that twirls his staff to radiate healing firework sparks, deal damage to enemies, and actively block incoming enemy projectile weapons.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Bayou Bash and Big Easy Impact both gain an additional continuous healing aura effect for the team.

teamUpAbilities.name: Mr. & Mrs. X
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Every attack triggers a kinetic explosion dealing area damage to surrounding enemies while healing nearby teammates (30s cooldown).
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: The kinetic explosion ability becomes completely passive and permanently active on Rogue without needing cooldowns.

teamUpAbilities.name: Defensive Fortification
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Expands the active range of defensive stance and dramatically scales up its flat damage reduction ratio.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Southern Brawl primary punch gains a heavy knockback effect that deals bonus damage if enemies collide with walls.

teamUpAbilities.name: Gumbo Chimichangas
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Propels Deadpool into a forward leaping arc, scattering a ring of kinetically charged explosive chimichangas around enemies.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: The explosion radius from the chimichangas applies a direct stun effect to all caught enemies.

teamUpAbilities.name: Hell Yeah Honey

teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: If Hela is actively on your team, you can simultaneously upgrade BOTH weapons instead of choosing just one.

teamUpAbilities.name: Gumbo Chimichangas
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Activating the skill triggers kinetic energy that propels Deadpool into a forward leap, scattering a ring of kinetically charged chimichangas that deal area damage.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: The blast radius from the landing chimichangas inflicts a direct crowd control stun effect to all caught enemies.

teamUpAbilities.name: Hell Yeah Honey
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Allows weapons to level up one extra time. Level 3 Desert Eagles gain bullet pierce and homing death rattle bubbles. Level 3 Katanas inject undead energy that detonates for percentage-based true damage scaling off max health.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: If Hela is actively on your team, you can simultaneously upgrade BOTH the Desert Eagles and the Katanas instead of choosing just one weapon upgrade.

teamUpAbilities.name: Gumbo Chimichangas
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Leaps forward to scatter a ring of kinetically charged chimichangas dealing damage to enemies and additionally providing a burst of healing to allies.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: The explosion radius from the landing chimichangas inflicts a direct crowd control stun effect to all caught enemies.

teamUpAbilities.name: Hell Yeah Honey
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Allows weapons to level up one extra time. Level 3 Desert Eagles pierce and create homing death rattle bubbles that explode to heal allies. Level 3 Katanas inject undead energy for extra personal healing on detonation.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: If Hela is actively on your team, you can simultaneously upgrade BOTH the Desert Eagles and the Katanas instead of choosing just one weapon upgrade.

teamUpAbilities.name: Prehistoric Trap
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Upgrades Smoky Snare traps to summon a Diablo minion that physically immobilizes targets while spraying continuous tracking poison gas.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Elsa can store, cycle, and deploy up to two independent localized smoky snare minion traps simultaneously.

teamUpAbilities.name: Loudmouth Mercs
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Passive: Living bullets swap to special rounds that taunt targets, slow, and deal damage over time before recalling to heal Elsa and add an instinct block.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Significantly amplifies the baseline acquisition rate of her Hunter Instinct passive gauge when paired with Deadpool.

teamUpAbilities.name: Feline Alliance
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Passive: Accumulating damage builds Vibranium energy that explodes at thresholds to deal knockback damage while granting speed and bonus health.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Removes the passive automatic threshold trigger, enabling Black Cat to manually detonate the stored Vibranium blast at will.

teamUpAbilities.name: Binding Ties
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Replaces Turn of Fortune with a dual-charge spiderweb grapple. Hooking enemies steals fortune resources and marks them with a Spider Tracer.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Attacking a target carrying a Spider Tracer with any active ability detonates the mark for bonus damage and temporarily immobilizes them in place.

teamUpAbilities.name: Primal Punishment
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Replaces Primal Bite with dual mounted magnetic cannons firing explosive rounds that apply bleed effects.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Enables the classic rider team-up: Punisher mounts his back to deliver massive synchronized fire support (12s cooldown).

teamUpAbilities.name: Surf & Turf
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Replaces impact laser beam with a frontal water spray that damages enemies while simultaneously healing teammates.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Jeff rides on top of Devil Dinosaur's head, granting both units flat damage reduction and continuous passive healing.

teamUpAbilities.name: Phoenix Flame
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Ricochet Force inflicts continuous fire burn damage. Hitting burnt targets with Optic Blast or Concussive Beam detonates remaining burn values instantly.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Every spark detonation triggered across the battlefield directly reduces the active remaining cooldown of Ricochet Force.

teamUpAbilities.name: Kinetic Kin
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: New active skill on a 15s cooldown that expends stored energy to grant Cyclops significantly increased movement speed and vertical jump height properties.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: During the active kinetic mobility state, weapon firing speeds for both Optic Blast and Concussive Beam are significantly increased.

teamUpAbilities.name: Hellfire Sparks
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: When attack speed is enhanced, her primary fire transforms into a hitscan attack capable of scoring critical hits and granting personal self-healing on hit.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: The void magic mark is never cleared, allowing Jubilee to indefinitely sustain her powerful hitscan attack form.

teamUpAbilities.name: Vampiric Kin
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Deploys a vampiric field on the ground that grants all occupying allies active life steal benefits when attacking enemies.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Allies inside the vampiric field receive an additional continuous flat healing effect over time alongside the lifesteal.

teamUpAbilities.name: Lucky Lone
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Receives an orb of life converting energy into a Nine-Tailed aura that tracks units in all directions, granting speed/healing to allies and damaging/slowing enemies.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Using the orb triggers a temporary state where spirit tail energy is not consumed, allowing free use of Spectral Surge and Fox Form Awakening.

teamUpAbilities.name: Psionic Fox
teamUpAbilities.baseDescription: Activating Fox Form Awakening no longer consumes spirit tail energy as a base passive, immediately granting the maximum possible duration upon use.
teamUpAbilities.enhancedDescription: Drastically reduces the active cooldown of Fox Form Awakening down to a low 12-second rotation cycle.
